setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (1 review, 4 other sources): The Playin' through Around & Around stretch includes a China Cat tease in Not Fade Away; Not Fade Away contains a China Cat tease [1][3][4][5][15]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): The Scarlet music is singled out as unbelievable, with Jerry and Phil playing standout riffs; A distinctive riff turns up about eleven minutes into Scarlet [6][11]
- **Dancin' In The Streets** (1 review, 1 other source): The Comes a Time into Dancin' sequence, then Not Fade Away and Dancin' again, is singled out as amazing; After Not Fade Away, Garcia seemed headed toward a Playin' reprise, but Lesh swung the band back into Dancin' [5][8]
- **Jam** (1 review): The jam just before Comes a Time is praised as rocking hard [8]
- **Comes A Time** (1 other source): Comes A Time lasts about 9:51, followed by an 8:26 Dancin' In The Street [5]

## The recordings

- **gd76-10-03.sbd-aud.cotsman.12832.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 161 min; rated 2.83/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Matrix recording is described as clear [14]
- **gd76-10-03.aud.weiner.19415.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 163 min; rated 3.81/5 by 16 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the audience recording's sound mediocre, around a 3 out of 5; Audience recording sounds decent, rated about 3 for sound; Reviewer calls the audience recording poor, nearly inaudible, and rates it 1 for recording quality [6][8][10][11]
- **gd1976-10-03.set2.sbd.jim.12829.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 94 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: The first half-note of Playin' is glitchy, like releasing pause on an old tape deck [3]
- **gd1976-10-03.121945.s2.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 95 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [4]

## Around the show

- Taper's own voice is audible at points; recording began after Sugaree had started, and the opening volume was too loud [7]
- A fan recalls waking up the day after another show and deciding to drive 350 miles to Detroit for this concert [21]
- Reviewer considers the whole second set long and great, rating the show far above the recording quality [6]
- Reviewer finds the 1976 sound less gripping than some other years, and nothing here stood out; still worth hearing [13]
- Reviewer ranks that second-set stretch among the band's top 50 jam segments, voted into a top 31 list [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-10-03.sbd-aud.cotsman.12832.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [1]. Also: Matrix: first set from audience source; second set from soundboard via MR and D to CD, with audience and FM soundboard patches [1]
- **gd76-10-03.aud.weiner.19415.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Humboldt? (see review); source: Audience Recording: Sony 153TDC? [2]
- **gd1976-10-03.set2.sbd.jim.12829.shnf**: transferred by Jim Bennett; source: SBD>MR>C>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [3]. Also: The first 42 seconds of Drums are patched from an unlabeled audience source [3]
- **gd1976-10-03.121945.s2.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [4]. Also: This source corrects an earlier version, which had a Dancin' in the Street patch from the 10/10/76 show [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1976-10-03 Sun Cobo Arena, Detroit, MI](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1309227882657/grateful-dead-1976-10-03-sun-cobo-arena) [22]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1976-10-03 Sun Cobo Arena, Detroit, MI](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1309227882657/grateful-dead-1976-10-03-sun-cobo-arena) [23]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1976-10-03 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1976-10-03-backstage-pass/) [24]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Grateful Dead@Cobo Arena Detroit MI 10 03 1976](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/grateful-dead-cobo-arena-detroit-mi-10-03-1976) [25]
- Poster by theconcertdatabase.com: [The Grateful Dead | The Concert Database](https://theconcertdatabase.com/concerts/grateful-dead-10) [26]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 10/3/76 Cobo Arena, Detroit, MI | …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759945573/) [27]
